title: Orientation Dock: Mini Manual & UX Asset Pack for First-Run Checklist
creator: Jared Kim
description: Design and deliver a compact, persistent "orientation dock" UI pattern for first-run users of the Redwood Console. The dock is a right-anchored mini-panel that surfaces a short checklist (4–5 steps), contextual tips, and a 'run sample' CTA. This ticket covers: wireframes, high-fidelity assets (SVG/PNG/Lottie), microcopy variants, empty-state illustrations, accessibility notes, and a small set of product screenshots for the release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized wireframes for desktop and narrow-width tablet
High-fidelity assets exported (SVG icons, 2x and 3x PNGs for screenshots, one Lottie entry animation) delivered to the assets repo
Microcopy variants A/B tested in prototype with 6 external reviewers and PM sign-off
Design tokens and CSS spec handed to frontend (colors, spacing, animations, aria attributes)
Demo screenshots (empty states and checklist progress at 0/2/4 steps) produced and linked in the PR
assets_needed: SVG: checklist-icons.svg (4 icons, line + filled states)
Figma file: Orientation Dock board (component variants & tokens)
screenshots: screenshot_dock_empty_1x.png - right dock + empty project state
engineering_notes: Prefer CSS transform for entry animation to avoid layout thrash; Lottie fallback if unsupported
Dock should be a lightweight React portal with minimal rerenders; advise using request-level memoization for checklist state
Need a backend flag (onboarding_dock_enabled) to gate rollout for Dedicated customers
Accessibility: trap focus only when the dock is expanded; ensure all interactive elements have aria-labels and keyboard shortcuts
qa_notes: Test transitions at 60/120/240ms to verify perceived latency on lower-end machines
Verify localization for German and Japanese: expanded character lengths for microcopy variants
Confirm screenshot exports match required 2x/3x pixel sizes and that no overlay UI elements occlude sample data
decisions: Use right-anchored dock instead of modal to reduce interruption and preserve console context
Limit checklist to 4 steps to keep first-run completion under 3 minutes on average
Use subtle bounce entrance (600ms) that respects reduced-motion user preference
rollback_plan: Feature gate and rollout phasing: deploy behind feature flag, enable for 10% of new signups for 48 hours; if crash/error rate > 0.5% or NPS regression in sample survey, toggle flag off and rollback CSS + JS bundle referencing dock assets.
